## Core Services

- **Web Product Engineering:** Full-stack development with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Python (FastAPI). High-performance, accessible, and SEO-optimized web apps.
- **AI Systems & Agent Tooling:** Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, multi-agent frameworks (CrewAI, LangChain, OpenAI API), custom AI SDKs, and automated LLM workflows.
- **Backend & Cloud Architecture:** Multi-tenant schemas, event-driven microservices, PostgreSQL query optimization, serverless workflows, Docker, and AWS deployments.
- **Mobile Development:** Flutter applications, offline-first mobile sync, and cross-platform UX.
- **Technical Consulting:** Architecture audits, performance tuning, MVP scoping, and team enablement.

## Shipped Work & Career Highlights

- **Pencil (B2B AI Ads Platform):** Architected metadata-driven multi-tenant schemas, event-driven microservices, and server-side document rendering (+65% PDF export speed).
- **Siren (AI Agent Communications):** Built core communication rails, published NPM and PyPI SDKs, and delivered production MCP servers reducing AI development cycle times by 80%.
- **Client Projects:** Salesforce synchronization pipelines (+12% API throughput), automated unstructured document extraction with FastAPI, and resilient e-commerce architectures.
